question: What effect does wearing the triple-staff mark have on the listed sins?
premises: The listed sins are the implied subject
Wearing the triple-staff mark is the cause
Destruction of those sins is immediate
inference: By wearing the triple-staff mark, the listed sins are immediately destroyed.
uncertainties: The term tridaṇḍa may refer to the triple ash mark in this context rather than a physical staff.
plain_english: They are immediately destroyed indeed by the wearing of the triple-staff mark.
